modelAvailability: First model already executed. Second model uses the existing wildcard route; its first meaningful consumption call determines availability, with no preflight or replacement sampling.
variation: Different keys, visible strings, JSX expression and corresponding interpolation obligations; same public contract and evaluator.
mechanicalMetric: Actual programRewrite tool-call count; also report total calls, repeated reads and entry discovery without assuming each repeated read is avoidable.
reuseBoundary: Original source capture used a different injected-skill runner/prompt, so it is not a paired natural-consumption baseline.
costBoundary: All observed token fields, optimization overhead and unknown actual USD retained separately; no invoice inferred from provider zero.
